description: Opt-in metadata the engine reads from the extra fields: includeExtendedTimestamps adds each entry's modification / access / creation instants (UT 0x5455, then NTFS 0x000a, then the DOS fields — the source says which; ISO-8601, UTC) and includeUnixIds its Unix uid / gid (Info-ZIP ux 0x7875, or null). Absent by default, so the default row is unchanged.
